name: Root Account Interactive Usage
description: The AWS account root user is the email-and-password owner of the whole account. Day-to-day work should use IAM roles, not root. When root is used in the console or API, someone has the keys to everything: billing, all IAM, every bucket. The only common legitimate case is a documented break-glass emergency. Any other root activity is a credential emergency until proven otherwise.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
